title: Async Endpoints and External Services
learning_objectives: Write async def endpoints that await an external service
Call several services concurrently with asyncio.gather
Map timeouts and upstream failures to 504 and 502
Test with fake async services injected as dependencies — no network
hints: For the list endpoint: `coros = [asyncio.wait_for(service.temperature(c), settings.timeout) for c in city]` then `await asyncio.gather(*coros, return_exceptions=True)`.
Map each result: `isinstance(r, asyncio.TimeoutError)` → "timeout", `isinstance(r, LookupError)` → "unknown city", other exceptions → "service error".

failure_feedback.advice: Wrap the call in asyncio.wait_for and catch TimeoutError (504), LookupError (404), then Exception (502).
Return one entry per requested city, in request order.
Start all calls together with asyncio.gather instead of awaiting them in a loop.
Use `return_exceptions=True` and turn each exception into an error entry.
